EmailTemplate.subject: Transition to Core/Emerging Growth Service Team
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Good morning/afternoon [Client Name],
We are transferring you to a Core/Emerging Growth Service Team effective [XYZ DATE] to ensure you are receiving the service most appropriate to your current business needs. You'll now work with a dedicated HR Specialist and a dedicated Client Liaison. They will help you strategize and expand your utilization of Insperity services to further meet your organization's needs while continuing to foster the relationship you and I have established.
I will update them on any outstanding projects to ensure your new team is up to speed.
Your new Client Liaison will reach out to you in the next several days for a formal introduction. In the meantime, please find new contact information below:
Client Liaison Contact Name Client Liaison Contact Info
HR Specialist Name HR Specialist Contact Info
Please continue to reach out to me for assistance until [XYZ date].
It was a genuine pleasure to work with you and I wish you continued success.
